# gws recipe: Batch invite to an event

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — the batch-invite-to-event recipe: add a list of attendees to an EXISTING Calendar event — get the event, patch it with `sendUpdates: all` and the new attendees, verify. No equivalent in lots 31-33: this is modifying an existing event, not creating one — an operation simple creation doesn't cover. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: a write command with notifications — always confirm with the user before executing; requires the `gws` binary and a Google account (browser OAuth is free); install the prerequisite `googleworkspace-cli-gws-shared` first. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
